note.explanation: Web development means using programming languages and tools to create, design, build, and maintain websites and web applications. HTML gives a page its structure, CSS controls its appearance, and JavaScript can make it interactive.
examples: A student uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to make a personal website; this is web development.
A business creates and maintains a website to sell its products; this is also web development.
note.checkAnswer: Web development is the process of creating websites and web applications using programming languages and tools.
note.simple: Web development is making and looking after websites. HTML provides structure, CSS makes pages look attractive, and JavaScript adds interactive features.
note.checkQuestion: Which technology makes a web page interactive?
note.title: Web Development
steps: Use HTML to create the structure of a web page.
Use CSS to control how the page looks.
Use JavaScript to add interactive features.
Build, test, and maintain the website.
note.answer: Web development is the process of creating websites and web applications using programming languages and tools.

options: Creating and maintaining websites and web applications
Writing documents without using a computer
rationales: This is correct because web development involves creating and maintaining websites and web applications.
This is incorrect because repairing hardware is not the meaning of web development.
This is incorrect because writing ordinary documents is not web development.
This is incorrect because connecting to the internet alone does not create a website.

mcqs.stem: Which technology is described as the skeleton or structure of a web page?
rationales: This is correct because HTML provides the structure of a web page.
This is incorrect because CSS is used to control the page's appearance.
This is incorrect because JavaScript is used to make a page interactive.
This is incorrect because a browser displays web pages but is not the page's structure.

mcqs.stem: Which technology makes a web page look nice by controlling its style?
rationales: This is correct because CSS styles the appearance of a web page.
This is incorrect because HTML provides the page's structure.
This is incorrect because JavaScript adds interactive behaviour.
This is incorrect because a text editor is a tool for writing code, not a styling language.

mcqs.stem: Which technology can make a web page interactive?
rationales: This is correct because JavaScript is used to make web pages interactive.
This is incorrect because HTML mainly provides structure.
This is incorrect because CSS mainly controls appearance.
This is incorrect because a web address identifies a location on the web but does not add interaction.

mcqs.stem: Which benefit of learning web development helps a learner understand how websites are made and how the internet works?
rationales: This is correct because digital literacy includes learning how websites are made and understanding the internet.
This is incorrect because entrepreneurship is about starting an online business or service.
This is incorrect because creativity is about designing appealing and interactive websites.
This is incorrect because career opportunities concern possible jobs in the IT industry.

mcqs.stem: Which benefit is practised when a developer works out why a website is slow and fixes it?
rationales: This is correct because finding and fixing a problem develops problem-solving skills.
This is incorrect because choosing a name does not describe the problem-solving benefit in the example.
This is incorrect because buying a computer is not the skill being practised.
This is incorrect because memorising web addresses does not explain how a developer fixes a website problem.

mcqs.stem: Which activity best shows the creativity benefit of web development?
rationales: This is correct because a portfolio can use creative layouts, colours, and interactive features.
This is incorrect because repairing a printer is not an example of creating a website.
This is incorrect because writing a paper letter does not use web development.
This is incorrect because installing a fan is unrelated to designing a web page.

options: Creating a website to sell handmade crafts
Learning how to fix a slow website
mcqs.stem: Which example best illustrates entrepreneurship using web development?
rationales: This is correct because creating a website to sell crafts is an example of starting an online business.
This is incorrect because fixing a slow website illustrates problem-solving.
This is incorrect because choosing colours illustrates styling and creativity, not starting a business.
This is incorrect because learning how websites are made illustrates digital literacy.

written.text: Discuss the fundamental differences between HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in the context of web development.
written.finalAnswer: HTML provides structure, CSS controls appearance, and JavaScript makes web pages interactive.

rubric.why: The answer must identify HTML's role in a web page.
rubric.how: State that HTML provides the structure or skeleton of the page.

rubric.why: The answer must distinguish CSS from the other technologies.
rubric.how: State that CSS controls the appearance or styling of the page.

rubric.why: The answer must explain the purpose of JavaScript.
rubric.how: State that JavaScript makes a page interactive or adds interactive behaviour.

rubric.why: The final comparison must bring the three different roles together.
rubric.how: Conclude that HTML provides structure, CSS controls appearance, and JavaScript adds interaction.

modelAnswer: HTML is used to create the structure of a web page; it is like the skeleton of the page.
CSS is used to style the web page and control its appearance.
JavaScript is used to make the web page interactive.
Thus, HTML gives a page structure, CSS controls how it looks, and JavaScript adds interactive features.

written.text: Explain the process of setting up a development environment for web development. By discussing the necessary softwares and tools.
written.finalAnswer: Use a code editor to write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; use a web browser to view and test the page; then correct errors and test again.

rubric.why: A development environment needs a tool for writing and editing code.
rubric.how: State that a code or text editor is used to write the web-page code.

rubric.why: The answer should connect the tools to the languages used for web development.
rubric.how: Mention HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as code written for the site.

rubric.why: A browser is needed to display and check the web page.
rubric.how: State that a web browser is used to view or test the page.

rubric.why: Testing and correcting errors are essential steps in preparing a working page.
rubric.how: Finish by explaining that the page should be tested and errors corrected.

modelAnswer: Choose a code editor or text editor to write the web-page code.
Use the editor to write HTML for the structure, CSS for the appearance, and JavaScript for interactive features.
Open the page in a web browser to view and test it.
Correct any errors and test the page again.

examTips: A short question may ask you to define web development; include both creating websites or web applications and using programming languages and tools.
A long question may compare HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; state the separate role of each technology clearly.
Questions about the benefits of web development may ask for examples such as digital literacy, career opportunities, problem-solving, creativity, or entrepreneurship.
For a comparison answer, earn marks by naming each technology and matching it to its correct purpose.

steps.why: This is the definition given in your textbook.
steps.text: Process of creating websites and web applications is called Web development.

steps.why: This explains that web development uses languages and tools to make and look after websites.
steps.text: It means using various programming languages and tools to design, build, and maintain websites.

example.question: What is web development?
example.answer: Web development is the process of creating websites and web applications using programming languages and tools.

explain.title: Meaning of web development
explain.body: Your textbook defines it as: “Process of creating websites and web applications is called Web development. It means using various programming languages and tools to design, build, and maintain websites.” In simple terms, web development is the work involved in making and looking after websites.

explain.title: Why learn it?
explain.body: Web development can help you understand how websites and the internet work, develop problem-solving and creative skills, find IT career opportunities, or create an online business.

explain.title: Three important technologies
explain.body: HTML is like the structure or skeleton of a web page. CSS makes the page look nice. JavaScript makes it interactive.

explain.title: A web development example
explain.body: If you create a personal blog, you can use HTML to organise its content, CSS to choose its layout and colours, and JavaScript to add interactive features.

mistakes: Do not define web development as only writing code; the textbook definition also includes designing, building, and maintaining websites.
Do not mix up the roles of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: HTML gives structure, CSS controls appearance, and JavaScript adds interaction.
When asked for a benefit, do not just list its name; give a relevant explanation or example.
In a long answer, explain each technology separately before giving the overall comparison.
